newsitem.title: USA: USDA seeks 7.286 mln lbs ground beef/beef patties.
newsitem.headline: USDA seeks 7.286 mln lbs ground beef/beef patties.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it was seeking to buy 7,286,400 lbs of frozen ground beef and beef patties for use in the National School Lunch Program and other Federal food assistance programs.
All offers must be in the format prescribed in LS-48 and be received by 1430 EDT in Washington, D.C., on Friday, October 18, 1996. Acceptances will be announced by midnight Friday, October 25, 1996.
Shipments must be made between November 27 and December 10, 1996, the AMS said.
